story.summaryZh: 国际汽联修订紧急措施，解除对俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手的限制，不再要求其承诺“中立”，允许他们以本国旗帜参赛。

story.originalTitle: FIA lifts sanctions on Russian, Belarusian drivers
story.summaryEn: The FIA has revised its emergency measures to lift restrictions on Russian and Belarusian drivers, no longer requiring them to commit to neutrality and allowing them to race under their national flag.
detailZh: 国际汽联解除对俄罗斯、白俄罗斯车手的制裁
由于俄乌战争而对俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手实施的限制被解除后，这些车手将获准在各自国旗之下参赛。
国际汽联修订了其紧急措施，解除了对俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手的限制，不再要求他们承诺“中立”，从而撤销了在乌克兰战争爆发后对他们实施的措施。
2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，国际汽联对俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的组织和车手实施了一系列制裁。不允许在这两个国家举办任何国际赛事或比赛，其国家队也被排除在外。
所有车手、参赛者和官员还被要求签署中立承诺。车手们被允许在中立旗帜下参赛，或者在有资格从不受限制的ASN获得执照的情况下，在另一个国家的旗帜下参赛。
在8月早些时候的世界汽车运动理事会会议之后，俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手可以再次在各自国旗之下参赛，国家标志——如车队颜色或旗帜——也再次被允许。
国际汽联8月13日的通告中写道：“为避免疑义，俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手、参赛者和官员在特定国家的参与仍需遵守任何适用的跨国、国家和地方法律。”
丹尼尔·科维亚特，#88 VENTENY兰博基尼GT3
“国际汽联继续密切关注乌克兰的事件，并保留在未来采取任何进一步行动或实施进一步措施的权利，包括为遵守任何适用制裁制度下的义务和/或国际汽联作为一方的任何合同而采取的任何必要行动。”
这些变化并不扩展到在俄罗斯或白俄罗斯举办国际赛事，这些赛事继续属于限制范围。国际汽联在2022年取消了俄罗斯大奖赛的合同，该赛事原定是索契赛车场举办的最后一场比赛，因为伊戈拉车道计划在2023年接手。
最近几周，俄罗斯田径联合会向体育仲裁法庭提出申诉，试图解除世界田径对其施加的制裁。此前，其在国际奥委会的暂停资格被暂时解除，尽管国际奥委会提出了建议，但世界田径并未效仿。
如果国际奥委会暂时解除制裁的决定保持不变，俄罗斯运动员理论上可以代表自己的国家参加2028年洛杉矶奥运会。
在赛车界，俄罗斯车手往往转而使用不同的ASN来继续参赛：罗伯特·施瓦茨曼在以色列旗帜下参赛，而丹尼尔·科维亚特和尼基塔·贝德林等人则持有意大利赛车执照。哈萨克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦等国也曾有俄罗斯车手代表参加各级别青年赛事。
关于俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手、国家队、参赛者和官员的修订方针：
• 俄罗斯和白俄罗斯车手、国家队、个人参赛者和官员被允许无任何限制地参加国际/区域赛事。签署中立承诺的要求不再适用。
• 在国际/区域赛事中，允许展示俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的国家标志、颜色、旗帜（制服、装备和赛车），以及奏响其国歌。
以下国际汽联紧急措施将继续有效：
• 在另行通知之前，不在俄罗斯和白俄罗斯境内举办国际/区域赛事。
detailEn: FIA lifts sanctions on Russian, Belarusian drivers
Racing drivers from Russia and Belarus will be permitted to race under their national flag, after restrictions placed on them due to the Russo-Ukrainian war were lifted

The FIA has revised its emergency measures to lift restrictions on Russian and Belarusian drivers and no longer binds them to a commitment of 'neutrality', walking back on the measures placed on them following the outbreak of the war in Ukraine.

After Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022, the FIA introduced a series of sanctions against Russian and Belarusian organisations and drivers. No international events or competitions were permitted to take place in either nation, and their national teams were also excluded.

All drivers, competitors, and officials were also required to sign a commitment to neutrality. The drivers were permitted to run under a neutral banner, or under the flag of another nation so long as they were eligible to receive a licence from an unrestricted ASN.

Following a World Motor Sport Council meeting earlier in August, Russian and Belarusian drivers can once again race under their flag, and national symbols – such as team colours or flags – are once again permitted.

The FIA's circular, dated on 13 August, states: "For the avoidance of doubt, the participation of Russian and Belarusian drivers, competitors and officials in a given country remains subject to compliance with any applicable transnational, national and local laws.
Daniil Kvyat, #88 VENTENY Lamborghini GT3

"The FIA continues to carefully monitor the events in Ukraine and reserves the right to take any further actions or implement further measures in the future, including any necessary actions required to comply with its obligations under any applicable sanctions regime and/or any contracts to which the FIA is a party."

The changes do not extend to holding international events in Russia or Belarus, and these continue to be part of the restrictions. The FIA cancelled its contract for the Russian Grand Prix in 2022, set to be the final race for the Sochi Autodrom as the Igora Drive circuit was planned to take over in 2023.

In recent weeks, the Russian Athletics Federation has filed a claim with the Court of Arbitration for Sport in an effort to get sanctions placed upon it by World Athletics removed. This follows the provisional removal of its suspension from the International Olympics Committee, although World Athletics has not followed suit despite the IOC's recommendations.
Russian athletes could theoretically compete for their country in the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles, should the IOC's provisional lifting of sanctions remain.

In motorsport circles, Russian drivers have tended to switch to a different ASN to continue competing: Robert Shwartzman raced under an Israeli flag, while the likes of Daniil Kvyat and Nikita Bedrin have Italian racing licences. The likes of Kazahkstan and Kyrgyzstan have also been represented by Russian drivers across the junior categories.
Revised approach with respect to Russian and Belarusian drivers, national teams, competitors and officials:

• Russian and Belarusian drivers, national teams, individual competitors and officials are allowed to participate in international/zone competitions without any restrictions. The requirement of signing a commitment to neutrality no longer applies.
• The display of Russian and Belarusian national symbols, colours, flags (uniform, equipment and car), and the playing of their anthems are permitted at international/zone competitions.
The following FIA emergency measures shall remain in place:
• No international/zone competition to take place on the territory of Russia and Belarus, until further notice.
keyPointsZh: 俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的车手、国家队、个人参赛者及官员可无限制参加国际/区域赛事，无需签署中立承诺。
国际/区域赛事中允许展示俄罗斯和白俄罗斯的国家标志、颜色、旗帜（制服、装备和赛车）以及奏响国歌。
在俄罗斯和白俄罗斯境内举办国际/区域赛事的禁令仍然有效。
keyPointsEn: Russian and Belarusian drivers, national teams, individual competitors and officials are allowed to participate in international/zone competitions without any restrictions, and the requirement of signing a commitment to neutrality no longer applies.
The display of Russian and Belarusian national symbols, colours, flags (uniform, equipment and car), and the playing of their anthems are permitted at international/zone competitions.
No international/zone competition is to take place on the territory of Russia and Belarus until further notice.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
